newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BARCO SELLS LIGHT SOURCE STAKE TO X-RITE.
newsitem.headline: BARCO SELLS LIGHT SOURCE STAKE TO X-RITE.

text.p: Belgian electronics group Barco NV said on Tuesday it agreed to sell its 15 percent stake in digital colour measurement systems company Light Source to Nasdaq-listed X-Rite Inc of the U.S.

Barco said it agreed to sell the stake in Light Source to permit the further expansion of the company. Barco bought its stake in September 1995 to access know-how in colour technology. Light Source's systems are used among other things in printing.
X-Rite is a leading world producer of advanced quality control systems and colour measuring instruments for paints, plastics and other industries, Barco said in a statement.
Barco would maintain its relation with X-Rite/Light Source, using Light Source software in its graphics products.
Barco said 1996 results included a sufficient provision for a potential depreciation on the Light Source investment.
